target_customer: L&D, education, onboarding, creators, small business and developers who need explainer videos
problem: Making explainer videos is slow and costly; Simi turns prompts and documents into narrated whiteboard videos in seconds, via app and API.
business_model: Freemium subscription ($19.99 per month for 6,000 credits) plus usage API

founders.name: Sudip Rokaya
founders.background_notes: ML research at MIT McGovern Institute; represented Nepal at the International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics.

competitors.name: Golpo AI
competitors.what: Prompt or document to narrated whiteboard video
competitors.traction_then: Vendor claims about 10 minutes per video

competitors.name: VideoScribe
competitors.what: Timeline based whiteboard animation with AI script writer

technical_complexity.rationale: Near real time structured video generation with narration and API needs custom pipelines but uses existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Several competitors already offered prompt to whiteboard video.

market_need_then: Training and education teams need fast video; the founders pitch Simi as a visualization layer for AI answers.

branding.domain_note: Site is laminalabs.ai with API at api.laminalabs.ai

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident, short declarative lines

branding.community_and_virality: Demo Day coverage in Nepali media

brand_strength.rationale: Coverage in Nepali outlets and aggregators after the raise; modest product brand.

outcome_analysis: Lamina Labs, a two person MIT founded Spring 2026 company, announced $4.8 million on July 30, 2026 after Demo Day, which is a strong early raise for its stage. Simi has a priced product and API, but several whiteboard video generators already exist, so differentiation on speed and cost matters.
notes: $4.8M seen at Runtimewire and Hamropatro; Entrepreneurloop reports $3M and $500K from YC, conflicting, so not recorded. Round stage not stated, so other. The company site lists Foundation Capital and Link Ventures as backers but no source ties them to the round, so investors left empty. Name origin not found.
